He sold his stake in 2020, then built Yoda into a Cyprus-listed investment group spanning property, hospitality, shipping, energy, healthcare and technology.

long_biography.plain_text:
Globalworth founder Ioannis Papalekas helped establish the company's foundation around education, health, community building and technology. Globalworth funded projects delivered with local charities in Romania and Poland, including community centres, healthcare access, learning technology and school support. Papalekas also made a personal donation to a multi-year United Way Romania programme for vulnerable children and their families.

He has traced his interest in giving to his parents and late grandfather, who devoted himself to philanthropy and community service in a small Greek town. After arriving in Romania in 2000, Papalekas supported charities for years before the foundation was created. During the pandemic, its Polish operation supplied hospitals with protective equipment, intensive-care beds and meals for medical staff.
